g.text: Select Unmatched Movies & Dispatch 5 Concurrent Workers
WHERE movieId NOT LIKE 'tt%' AND NOT pending in match_review_queue • ORDER BY attemptedAt IS NOT NULL ASC, attemptedAt ASC
Per movie: extractSourceMetadata() cleans channel title, strips promo-tag years, extracts director / cast / original title / slug hints
Direct IMDb URL / tt* ID Regex
Scans source description & title for imdb.com/title/tt\d{7,9} or bare tt\d{7,9}.
Zero search APIs, zero LLM calls — fetches OMDb metadata and migrates immediately.
Local-First Fast Path (<2ms SQLite + ~250ms Jev, 0 Search APIs)
1. Deterministic: tier === 'auto_accept' AND score ≥ 85 AND (yearScore > 0 OR peopleScore > 0) AND gap ≥ 10
2. Local Jev Fast Path (topScore ≥ 45): adjudicateCandidatesWithJev() → match ≥0.85 (+OMDb check) OR not_a_movie ≥0.85
Skips ALL external search APIs & Gemini whenever local imdb-index.db + Jev already resolve the movie!
Tiers 3–7 run in PARALLEL (Promise.allSettled), merged in deterministic tier order:
Gated Tail Fallbacks (only triggered when candidate pool is still thin):
Scores all candidates (title, year, runtime, director/cast). Auto-accepts ONLY when:
tier === 'auto_accept' AND (yearScore > 0 OR peopleScore > 0) AND gap ≥ 10
1. Hydrates top 5 candidates from local imdb-index.db + top 3 Plot/Director/Actors from OMDb (cached).
2. Jev (jev-latest) choice first (~300ms, ≥0.85 match / not_a_movie) → uncertain falls back to Gemini / gpt-4o-mini.
3. If verdict='match' & conf ≥ 0.85 → final OMDb runtime sanity check; if isNotAMovie → skips Pass 4 immediately.

svg.text: no confident Pass-1 match (records Pass-1 rejected IDs)

g.text: Phase 2: LLM Query Planner + Parallel Fan-Out + Re-Adjudication
Reads raw title, Archive slug / YouTube description, channel, duration & Pass-1 rejected candidates.
Outputs: isMovie (false for newsreels/trailers/ads/talks), canonicalTitle, originalTitle, altTitles, year, director/cast, webQueries[2].
Filters out Pass-1 rejected IDs, hydrates fresh top candidates (local IMDb + cached OMDb), runs adjudicateCandidates().
If verdict='match' & conf ≥ 0.85 + passes OMDb runtime check → Auto-Match! Otherwise falls through to Queue / No Match.
Uncertain Candidate → Review Queue | No Candidate → No Match
• If Pass 1 or Pass 2 LLM returned verdict = 'uncertain' or 'match' with conf < 0.85 (with a candidate ID) → enqueue kind='new_match'.
• Otherwise (no candidates, or LLM confirmed mismatch) → record no_match in match_attempts.
• On transient error → record error (does not blacklist candidates).
Serialized SQLite Commits + Live SSE Progress & ETA
• Every movie commits immediately via serializeDbWrite() — safe to restart the server at any time without losing progress.
• emitProgress({ type: 'audit', current: scanned, total, estimatedTimeRemaining: computeEtaSeconds(...) }) streams live to Admin UI.
• Next run automatically starts with never-attempted movies (match_attempts.attemptedAt IS NULL), then cycles oldest-attempted first.
